Hi, I’m Nadish. I enjoy understanding the whole picture — how an interface talks to an API, and how that API works with data.

I’m a second-year Computer Science & Engineering undergraduate at the University of Moratuwa. I learn by building web and desktop applications, working through the details, and collaborating with others.

My work ranges from clinical consultations in a team project to complete booking and attendance systems. I’ve also explored digital hardware through a nanoprocessor project in Vivado.
